id: # The skills that change a plot (skills.md, "Plots"). One row for each rule. A skill can have many rows, and a pack can add rows for any skill.
# skill: the number in skills.tsv. plot: a key of plots.tsv, or any.
# condition: always, lower_intellect (the target has lower intellect), higher_intellect (the target has higher intellect), no_female (the target unit has no female officer).
# outcome: sure (the plot always succeeds), critical (a successful plot has the larger effect), double (two times the chance).
